latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Unified Video Lyrics.

- Instantly syncs song lyrics as animated captions across entire videos in a unified style.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB; backend processes and delivers a 1080p MP4 in 30–60 seconds.
- No manual captioning needed—just describe your requirements and get automatic AI lyric syncing.
- Cloud rendering pipeline with easy export, credit balance checks, and automatic session handling.
- Designed for musicians and content creators who want fast, consistent lyric videos.
